arithmetic: integers, finite sets, exact fractions; F2 for linear completion examples

groups.name: finite_grounding
groups.domain: All one-operation machines on n=1,2,3 states, all binary output labels, all evidence partitions; continuation words through n+1.

groups.name: nondestructive_revision
groups.domain: Three immutable cases; every binary target, every retained partition, every ordered pair of binary tests; all test subsets and depth-two adaptive trees.

groups.name: destructive_and_reset_controls
groups.domain: Three one-shot cases with two destructive tests, depths 0..5; eight sensor worlds (s,theta,k).

groups.name: correction_memory
groups.domain: All 256 candidate subsets of eight sensor worlds; theta partition, target s; all four atom-union observations, sixteen correction profiles, and their separators.

groups.name: noisy_identification
groups.domain: Two Bernoulli models p=1/4,3/4; exact strings through length seven and odd majority errors through length nineteen.

groups.name: ambiguity_radius
groups.domain: All nonempty subsets of {-1,0,1}^2, midpoint radius versus exact half-grid minimax; one explicit compression union.

groups.name: calibrated_continuation
groups.domain: All two-operator restrictions from a one-dimensional subspace of F2^2; all 16 completions of each pair, all four initial vectors and word lengths through three. A three-dimensional escape example is also exhausted.

groups.name: approximate_continuation
groups.domain: Exact rational 2x2 operators, calibrated line span(e1), induced l1 norms, powers through six. Explicit ambient-growth negative control.

non_claim: Finite checks illustrate the proofs. They are not general theorem verification, trained-agent results, or empirical generalization.
